# Signalsmith Stretch 1.3.2, with DeckMix's bass pitch fix (v0.9.27)

The key lock's pitch shifter. This is the author's JS/WASM web release of [Signalsmith Stretch](https://signalsmith-audio.co.uk/code/stretch/)
(MIT, `LICENSE.txt`), rebuilt from source with one change: `fix-bass-pitch.patch`. The app still imports it as `'signalsmith-stretch'`;
`package.json` points that name here (`file:vendor/signalsmith-stretch`) instead of at npm.

## Why

1.3.2 put every shifted note a fixed 1-2.5 Hz sharp. A fixed number of Hz barely matters at 440 Hz and is most of a semitone in the bass,
so a key-locked deck played its bassline out of tune against the other deck. The cause is in the phase prediction: to move a note it mixes
the phases of two neighbouring FFT bins, but each bin's phase was measured against its *own* centre frequency, so the mix is pulled towards
the louder bin. The patch rotates each bin's phase change to the in-between frequency first, then mixes (about 10 lines).

## Measured (07/10, the app's setting: 60 ms block, 15 ms interval, 48 kHz)

Pitch of a sine through the node, error in cents. Same numbers in Chromium (OfflineAudioContext) and in `tests/platform/keylock-pitch.test.ts`.

| tone | shift | npm 1.3.2 | this build |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 50 Hz | -2 st | +103.9 | +2.5 |
| 50 Hz | -1.33 st | +86.1 | +1.9 |
| 60 Hz | -2 st | +71.8 | -4.9 (worst found) |
| 100 Hz | -1.33 st | +43.4 | -0.5 |
| 100 Hz | +2 st | +33.0 | +0.5 |
| 440 Hz | -0.3 st | +8.8 | 0.0 |
| 440 Hz | +2 st | +5.4 | -0.2 |

Over 50 Hz-3 kHz and shifts -2 to +2 semitones the worst was +103.9 cents before and -4.9 after. The output level did not change
(0.97-1.00 of the input). Cost: rendering 3 s took 57-63 ms before and 71 ms after (Chromium, offline, two runs), 13-25% more work, still
roughly 2.5% of one core per keyed deck. Latency is unchanged (the block sets it).

## Rebuilding

`bash vendor/signalsmith-stretch/build.sh` - it pins the library commit, Signalsmith Linear 0.1.1 and emsdk 3.1.73. The pins are proven:
without the patch, the same recipe rebuilds the npm 1.3.2 file byte for byte. An emsdk newer than 3.1.73 builds a file that hangs inside
the AudioWorklet (details in `build.sh`); the test catches that too.

## Lint

`.oxlintrc.json` ignores `vendor/**`: this file is generated by `build.sh`, and its 31 warnings would bury the app's own.

## Upstream

The fix has not been offered to the author yet. `fix-bass-pitch.patch` is ready to send; once a release carries it, this folder can go
back to the npm package (the test will say whether it really did).
